label: Six ways businesses lose customers online, and how we fix each one
title: Six ways businesses [lose customers] online.
lead: Most businesses lose buyers in at least one of these places. **Each one can be fixed.**
ghostText: Keep scrolling to see what we do about it.

problems.title: Slow [website]
problems.problem: Buyers tap your link and leave before the page loads.
problems.fix: We build fast websites. Omek's phone score went from 50 to 95.
problems.fixNote: Omek's phone score went from 50 to 95. Google PageSpeed, phone, 6 Jul to 18 Sep 2026.

problems.title: Late [replies]
problems.problem: A buyer messages in the evening. By morning, they have bought elsewhere.
problems.fix: An AI automation replies straight away, day or night. Our own sent its first reply in 64 seconds.
problems.fixTitle: An AI automation replies straight away, day or night.
problems.fixText: Our own sent its first reply to a new enquiry in 64 seconds.

problems.title: Hard [to find]
problems.problem: Buyers search for what you sell and find other businesses first.
problems.fix: We set up your Google Business Profile, list you in 15 directories a month and tune your pages.

fixPoints.text: We set up your Google Business Profile
We list you in **15** directories a month

problems.title: Quiet [social pages]
problems.problem: When you get busy, posting stops and buyers forget you.
problems.fix: We make and post AI videos for you every week. No shoot day.
problems.summary: Posting stops when you are busy
problems.fixTitle: We make and post AI videos for you every week.
problems.fixText: videos a month, with no shoot day.

problems.title: Ads with [no enquiries]
problems.problem: Your ads get likes, but the phone does not ring.
problems.fix: We run Facebook, Instagram and Google ads and judge them by enquiries and sales.
problems.fixTitle: Ads judged by enquiries and sales.
problems.fixText: We run Facebook, Instagram and Google ads and judge them by enquiries and sales.

problems.title: Calling the [wrong people]
problems.problem: Your sales time goes on old lists and wrong numbers.
problems.fix: Every month, a checked list of businesses that fit your ideal customer, each with a reason to call.
problems.fixText: checked leads delivered to a client in two weeks.
problems.fixNote: Every month, a checked list of businesses that fit your ideal customer, each with a reason to call.

closeText: Start with a free check-up of your website. We check its speed, how it works on phones and how you show up on Google, then send you a short list of what to fix first.
